task: Vendor three Vercel Next.js/React agent skills (vercel-react-best-practices, vercel-react-view-transitions, vercel-composition-patterns) from github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills into .claude/skills/ as committed project skills
acceptanceCriteria: three vendored skill directories exist under .claude/skills with valid SKILL.md frontmatter
no pre-existing skill directory was modified or removed
the three vendored skill directories are visible to git
MIT license and upstream source are recorded in-tree
format:check lint typecheck and test:unit all exit 0
blastRadius: Agent tooling only. No application code, no runtime dependency, no build input. The vendored files are markdown and JSON read by coding agents; they never reach the Next.js bundle. Risk concentrates in two places: the .gitignore pattern block (a wrong line could un-ignore vendored node deps under .claude/) and the content of the skills themselves, which agents follow with full permissions.
contracts: No public API, route, schema, or exported contract changes. The only contract-shaped artifact is skills-lock.json, newly introduced by the skills CLI.
